purpose: Factor the cube into durable modules without destructively moving files.

modules.label: Telos, constitution, dreams, open horizon
modules.plain: What the cube is trying to become and what it must never become.

modules.label: Source carriers, intake, document classes
modules.plain: What public or official source carriers exist before any claim is promoted.

modules.label: Preservation, fixity, capture, provenance
modules.plain: How citations become preserved, hashable, replayable, privacy-reviewed sources.

modules.label: Status, legal effect, orders, dockets
modules.plain: How legal/status signals are compared without overclaiming current legal status.

modules.label: Agency identity, jurisdictions, denominators
modules.plain: How source labels become, eventually, canonical agencies and comparable denominators.

modules.label: Claims, nonclaims, evidence, defeaters, rollback
modules.plain: How bounded claims, nonclaims, blockers, and correction propagation are represented.

modules.label: Privacy, harm, legal risk, role access
modules.plain: How the cube avoids turning public records into public harm.

modules.label: Public display and product views
modules.plain: What the public might eventually see, and which modules are blocked or allowed.

modules.label: Operations, reentry, next-office handoff
modules.plain: How a future session restarts without flattening the project or losing the point.

modules.label: Schemas, validation, file hashes, tooling
modules.plain: How structural checks, schemas, and machine-readable guarantees are maintained.

modules.label: DOJ SLS pilot surfaces
modules.plain: The first low-harm department/source-level pilot; useful but not the cube’s destiny.

modules.label: Seed, prior art, intake context
modules.plain: The originating project prompt and lessons imported from prior cubes.

modules.label: Synthetic examples and test fixtures
modules.plain: Safe examples that let the cube test display/model logic before live people or incidents.

modules.label: Quarantine and deferred materials
modules.plain: Things intentionally held away from claim/public paths.

modules.label: Audit and factorization surfaces
modules.plain: This revision’s inventory, factoring, debts, and reentry logic.

migration_policy: Use factor assignments as a map. Do not move legacy files until a migration receipt, redirect index, and validation check exist.

rev0017_addendum.effect: Adds lifecycle ontology overlay without migrating files or changing base factor module count.
